samples.visibilityNote: Designed mostly occluded grip position; not a measured visible human landmark or biomechanical measurement.

timingEvidence.explanation: The first retained transition covers about74% of the visible horizontal excursion. Remaining source cells are concentrated near the open endpoint; progress is nonuniform to avoid assigning equal time to very different visible displacements. One reviewed native equipment midpoint at progress61/166 divides the initial large gap; its placement follows the prescribed occluded grip position, while all human pixels remain source raster. Three reviewed native equipment references divide the large initial arc into about38pixel projected grip steps. Valid but redundant original cells6/7 are omitted; no generated human pixels are added or deformed.
